intro.lede: Mentors are people who do the work, around when a Pod gets stuck. You wouldn't be teaching. You'd be the person in the room who's done it before.
intro.terms: A single workshop, or a whole cycle. You choose.
intro.status: Start by helping at a workshop.

items.title: Drop in.
items.body: Sit with a Pod when it's stuck, and ask what they've tried.

items.title: Unblock.
items.body: Share what you know from doing the work: a shortcut, a pattern, a person to ask.

items.title: Watch them ship.
items.body: Be there at the Showcase when they show what they built.

items.title: You choose the time.
items.body: A single workshop, or a whole cycle.

items.title: Nothing to prepare.
items.body: You're there when a Pod gets stuck, not at the front of a room.

items.title: Side by side.
items.body: Beginners and experts, working on the same real problem.

items.title: Free, always.
items.body: Nothing to pay, and nothing to sell.

path.title: Bring what you know. Leave with a Pod that shipped.

steps.title: Create your account.
steps.body: Your free Upskilling account: sign in with Google, and tell us what you know.

steps.title: Help at a workshop.
steps.body: Pick one to lead or help at. It's how most Mentors start.

steps.title: Mentor Pods in a cycle.
steps.body: When a Pod gets stuck, you're the person who's done it before. New this cycle: your Mentor button.

steps.title: Keep showing up.
steps.body: Come back for the next Pod, or the next cycle. It gets easier every time.

button.title: The one who's done it.
button.body: Worn when you're with a Pod, so people know who to ask. It marks a role, not a certification.
